name: acro-bike
effect: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. Slower than the Mach Bike. Can perform various tricks, allowing the trainer to reach certain special areas.
shortEffect: More maneuverable than the Mach Bike, and allows hopping along rails.

flavorTextEntries.text: A folding bicycle capable of jumps and wheelies.
A folding bicycle that is capable of stunts like jumps and wheelies.
This folding Bike allows you to perform actions such as wheelies and bunny hops.
